ops.title: Bound JSON task blocker projection to selected IDs
ops.description: Owner: /root/fresh_disk_gap_relief. Independent confirmed source finding: labeled task list uses IndexedTasks, but JSON presentation calls TasksBlockingIndex unconditionally; notes/index.go34-40 then folds the full task corpus through ListTasks. Evidence: internal/cli/task.go1297-1310 and notes/index.go34-40 at current831c/main. Root confirmed this is distinct from ledger6cb. Next: inspect CLI/MCP/get/presenter consumers and batch reverse-dependency lookup for the actual selected task IDs through existing metadata/ref-posting helpers and snapshot authority. Preserve blockers outside the displayed filter, exact status/deletion/order/global behavior, cancellation and the existing optional-index-miss fallback. Avoid K namespace captures and all-task folds on the available warm index. PR131 remains independent. Carry this fix through source review, CI32/10000 real CLI/source-work cases, normal merge/public release/root-serialized install and natural affected-case verification. No local synthetic corpus/tests/builds.

ops.text: Selected-task JSON blocker arrays preserve outside-filter blockers and existing status, deletion, branch and ordering semantics for CLI and sibling MCP/get/presenter callers.

A batch projection uses one existing metadata/ref authority resolution for selected IDs, with no K full captures or all-task body fold on a warm available index; optional-index misses retain the approved fallback.
CI exercises real selected-task JSON at32/10000 tasks with outside-filter blockers and source-work counts, preserving existing correctness/error/cancellation contracts.
Independent source review, full required CI, normal merge/public release/root-serialized install and measured natural affected-case verification complete; no local synthetic corpus benchmark.
